'''Blazemist Originium Slug''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A wild creature infected by Originium with extremely high body temperatures. Its dorsal carapace is imbued with Originium dust with higher levels of activity.}}

==Overview==
A unique variant of [[Firemist Originium Slug]], Blazemist Originium Slugs have similar appearance with their counterpart, but it doesn't make them more of a threat; They still attack with either a ram, which deal Physical damage, or spew out acid and deal Nature damage at five spots. 

Blazemist Originium Slugs can still self detonate when their HP is below 50%, which kills them in the process, but also deals Physical damage and knock Operators back. Operators that got affected will be attached with an unstable material, which explode and deal Physical damage when receiving damage from other sources. This material wears off after a short period.
